document:0:396:0.text:
An ancient saying is engraved around the small hole at the center of the sundial.
"Time reveals all things."
document:0:396:0.source_cn:
孔隙周围镌刻着一圈古代字符，你辨认出上面刻着的是一句古老的谚语
“时间揭露万事”。
